entries.alt: Four fictional adult women share close side hugs and linked hands on a stone terrace above Queenstown, Lake Wakatipu and the Remarkables. Short New Zealand flag looks pair with blue platforms, silver ankle boots, green stilettos and crimson rainbow knee-high boots.

Four fictional adult women overlap in an extreme-close back hug beside Rotorua's turquoise geothermal pool and steaming boardwalk. Rust, turquoise, cobalt and charcoal star-trimmed looks frame their distinct faces, a crescent tattoo and an agency motif.

Four fictional adult women sit and lean into a linked-hand moment at a guarded Piha overlook above the black-sand beach and Lion Rock. Short black, white, red and New Zealand flag looks pair with rainbow boots, sculptural blue platforms and visible Silent King and star tattoos.

Four fictional adult women share a supported lap rest and joined hands on a terrace above Wellington harbor and Mount Victoria. New Zealand flag, ivory, red and navy looks pair with rainbow knee-high boots, silver pumps, red platforms and a crescent tattoo.
